parameters.query:
SELECT p.id as proposal_id, p.version as proposal_version, p.payload_hash, p.status as proposal_status, c.id as case_id, c.project_id, c.state as case_state, p.payload
FROM scopeledger.proposals p
JOIN scopeledger.cases c ON c.id = p.case_id
WHERE p.id = $1::uuid;

WITH challenge AS (
  SELECT c.challenge_id, c.one_time_code
  FROM scopeledger.issue_auth_challenge(
    $1::uuid,
    $2::uuid,
    'client',
    'client_decision',
    '127.0.0.1'
  ) c
),
token AS (
  SELECT v.review_token
  FROM challenge c,
  LATERAL scopeledger.verify_auth_challenge(c.challenge_id, c.one_time_code) v
)
SELECT d.decision_id, d.case_id, d.case_state, d.receipt_status
FROM token t,
LATERAL scopeledger.decide_proposal(
  t.review_token,
  $2::uuid,
  $3::integer,
  $4::text,
  $5::text,
  $6::text,
  $7::text,
  'corr-client-n8n'
) d;
